# Quant Research Platform — Roadmap

**Last updated:** 2026-10-18

| Stage | Name | Source | Status* |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Data & explorer app | brief | |
| S2 | Risk structure & classical portfolios | brief | |
| S3 | Feature discovery | brief | |
| S4 | Neural forecasting & forecast-driven portfolios | brief | |
| S5 | Reinforcement-learning trading agents (optional) | brief | |

*Written by `dt roadmap` from doc statuses and todo checkboxes; never hand-edited.

## S1: Data & explorer app
**Outline:** Load, clean and validate a daily S&P 500 dataset with point-in-time membership and delisted names, and explore it in a browser app.
**Skills:** data-analysis, frontend-design

## S2: Risk structure & classical portfolios
**Outline:** Remove market-wide factors, compare covariance estimates, and score minimum-variance, risk-parity and hierarchical risk-parity portfolios out of sample on a shared scoreboard.
**Skills:** data-analysis, null-hypothesis-testing

## S3: Feature discovery
**Outline:** Build candidate price and volume features and keep only those that show significant information gain over market-removed returns.
**Skills:** data-analysis, null-hypothesis-testing

## S4: Neural forecasting & forecast-driven portfolios
**Outline:** Forecast returns and volatility with neural sequence models on the surviving features and test whether portfolios driven by them beat the S2 portfolios on the scoreboard.
**Skills:** data-analysis, null-hypothesis-testing

## S5: Reinforcement-learning trading agents (optional)
**Outline:** Train reinforcement-learning trading/allocation agents in a backtest environment and test whether they beat the S2 portfolios on the scoreboard, in paper trading only.
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing
EOF
